author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The new Acer Predator Atlas 8 comes out swinging, with a price point that undercuts every other high-performing handheld PC. Let's take a look and see why it's the sleeper hit of the year.

More info: https://www.acer.com/us-en/predator/handheld-gaming/predator-atlas/predator-atlas-8
Buy one here: https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/ZVGxaK

Impressions video: https://youtu.be/kT3k5k0N-rU

This was a review unit sent to me on loan by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
